original_value: The SanDisk iXpand USB Flash Drive Go 128GB is the easy way to free up Memory. Keep your memories safe by simply plugging in the drive to automatically back up your photos, videos and contacts

result.paraphrase: The SanDisk iXpand USB Flash Drive Go 128GB offers an easy way to free up memory. Just plug in the drive to automatically back up your photos, videos, and contacts, helping keep your memories safe.
